**Defining the Web App**

I'm now concretely defining the project as a bodybuilding e-commerce web application. My thoughts have solidified the core product categories: proteins, vitamins, supplements, and athletic gear. I'm also planning essential features, including health tips and a shopping cart with secure payment options to drive profits for the owner. The initial technology will use React.


**Outlining App Structure**

I'm now outlining the application structure and tech stack. I'll be using React with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Google's Gemini API for health tips. I've got the project's folder structure roughed out, along with component names and key files. I'm focusing on responsiveness, modern UI/UX, and Gemini integration to meet my requirements. I'm also planning a dark mode theme for a bodybuilding/fitness aesthetic.


**Refining the Design**

I'm now implementing a sleek dark theme, "Pro-Gym," with amber/orange highlights. I'm focusing on high-quality images from `picsum.photos`, specifically fitness-related categories. Functionality includes category-based search/filter, a shopping cart, and an "AI Health Coach" (a text-based interface) powered by `gemini-3-flash-preview` for quick, science-based advice. I'll stick to text-based AI for this standard store, and will have an elite bodybuilding coach and nutritionist system prompt. I'm streamlining the product details for a single-page app and adding to cart functionality.
